verdict.rationale: stagewise auto-generates a WORKSPACE.md in .stagewise/ as the agent's primary high-level project context, and supports SKILL.md files that teach project-specific patterns, workflows, and constraints. However, the docs don't say that WORKSPACE.md is user-editable for coding standards, and skills are task-scoped, invoked via slash commands, rather than an always-applied rules file. Missing for 10: an explicit user-authored, always-applied project instructions/rules file (e.g. AGENTS.md-style) for conventions, documentation of editing WORKSPACE.md to enforce standards, and independent corroboration that the agent follows such instructions.
